description: Cancel an open order by `orderId`. Returns `{ success, message, code }`. Side effect: marks the order non-matchable and refunds locked balance per backend rules; effectively destructive on the live order. Idempotent — cancelling an already-cancelled order is a no-op success. Fails for fulfilled orders or unauthorized callers. Requires a wallet signature identity (the order's owner). Verify state with `tronsave_get_order` first; prefer `tronsave_update_order` when only price/receiver should change.

orderId.description: Target order id (`MObjectId`) to cancel. Must be an active order owned/authorized by the current session; already-fulfilled or already-cancelled orders are expected to fail.

name: tronsave_cancel_order

anyOf.description: GraphQL mutation status code (HTTP-like; `0`/`200` indicates success). Always pair with `success` for routing.

code.description: GraphQL mutation status code (HTTP-like; `0`/`200` indicates success). Always pair with `success` for routing.

anyOf.description: Human-readable status text. Populated even on success; localized error messages may appear here on failure.

message.description: Human-readable status text. Populated even on success; localized error messages may appear here on failure.
